scenario: Open Agent contact intake from an existing relationship.
Enter the existing synthetic person's name and a previously unknown email identity clue.
Observe one name-only candidate rather than the entire account directory.
Select the existing Advisor network relationship, explicitly confirm that the masked email clue belongs to this person, and attach a recruiter-owned identity note.
Observe a completed source-attachment receipt stating that no duplicate identity or relationship was created and that one masked source-linked clue was stored.
Read back the database and confirm one person, three active relationship contexts, six governed sources, and one confirmed email handle containing a hash, masked hint, and source identifier.
Start a second contact draft with the unrelated name Reloaded Alias Check and the same raw email.
Observe one candidate: Synthetic Agent Contact 0807, matched by Confirmed Email, with the raw value masked and source linkage disclosed.
Observe that new-person creation is disabled because the confirmed handle already has an account-scoped owner.
Reload the page and repeat the unrelated-name lookup; the same confirmed-handle result and duplicate-prevention boundary remain.

identity_behavior.confirmed_handle_role: deterministic candidate narrowing, not automatic merge authority
identity_behavior.confirmation_authority: explicit recruiter checkbox plus governed contact-record source
identity_behavior.directory_result: masked display hint and source identifier only

observed_receipt.title: Source attached to existing relationship
observed_receipt.detail: The source was attached to the selected existing person and relationship. No duplicate identity or context was created. One confirmed identity clue is stored as a source-linked masked handle.

negative_and_recovery_cases.unknown_email_with_name: returns only the matching name candidate; does not return the account directory
negative_and_recovery_cases.reload: confirmed-handle lookup and duplicate-prevention state persist

remaining_limits: The runtime proof exercises one confirmed email owner, not multiple conflicting handles or two plausible same-name people.
The UI can show several candidates and their match reasons but does not yet persist an unresolved identity-review case from the Agent draft.
The operation receipt remains transient after reload.
The proof is local and synthetic rather than field evidence from working recruiters.
